name: anvil
description: Keeps the prompt cache warm while you are away and stops an accidental cold send, draws a line above the prompt with the folder, git status, 5h and 7d usage and session cost, and adds each reply's output speed to its closing line

threshold.title: 上下文阈值
threshold.description: 单位 token。上下文达到它的会话自动开启缓存保活，冷发送守卫也只拦这类会话

autoKeepalive.title: 自动开启缓存保活
autoKeepalive.description: 决定默认：开着时，上下文达到阈值的会话自动开启缓存保活；单个会话可用 /anvil keepalive 切换开关，不受这项和阈值限制

guard.title: 冷发送守卫
guard.description: 缓存已过期且上下文达到阈值时，拦下发给模型的第一条消息一次，提示重建代价
